gloss_en: Windows from an Archicad IFC land outside the wall face in 3D after Open IFC in Revit 2025-2027; worked in 2024.
title_original: PR: When importing IFC files, windows are positioned outside the wall face in the 3D view
question_paraphrase: Opening an Archicad IFC in Revit 2025-2027 puts windows outside the wall face in 3D, regardless of the 2D annotation setting. Not present in Revit 2024.
phrasing_notes: Bug-report template; regression framing by Revit version; attaches zip
answer_summary: Acknowledged as a bug (Jira ticket); tracked separately from the 2D-symbol issue.

gloss_en: Archicad 2D symbols/annotations carried as FootPrint geometry make doors and windows mis-positioned in walls in Revit 2025-2027.
title_original: PR: 2D symbol/annotation causes doors and windows to be incorrectly positioned in the wall.

phrasing_notes: Terse bug report; with/without comparison files
answer_summary: Treated separately: 2D plan symbols and door swings arrive as FootPrint geometry; engineering tracking.

gloss_en: What is the difference between Open IFC and Link IFC in Revit; Tekla assemblies become in-place families or duplicate geometry.
title_original: IFC Import - Link Vs Open
question_paraphrase: Open IFC creates in-place families without IFC data and cannot map classes for assembly sub-elements; Link IFC duplicates assembly and parts. Asks for official direction.
phrasing_notes: Measured, comparative, polite, asks for roadmap
answer_summary: Autodesk: Open and Link are separate code paths (old C++ vs new C# open-source); plan to unify.

gloss_en: Link IFC should convert IfcSpace to Rooms (arch model) or Spaces (MEP model) instead of generic models.
title_original: Link IFC does not create Room/Space from IfcSpace
question_paraphrase: IfcSpace imported as generic models obstructs views; MEP engineers must use Open IFC just to get Rooms.
phrasing_notes: Short title, practical complaint in comments
answer_summary: Maintainer asked how to decide Room vs Space; open since 2018.

gloss_en: Linking an IFC aligns IFC project north (+Y) to Revit true north instead of project north.
title_original: Revit should not link IFCs and make project north = grid north
question_paraphrase: Link IFC rotates the model by the angle between project and true north; worked in Revit 2020 but broken in 2022.
phrasing_notes: Technical, precise, uses Project North/True North terms
answer_summary: Maintainers confirm understanding; test: link IFC then link generated .ifc.rvt and compare orientation.

gloss_en: Linking an IFC and linking its generated .ifc.rvt give different project-north rotations; users share the .ifc.rvt to save load time and clean Tekla files.
title_original: PR: Different project north rotations depending on linking in IFC and corresponding .ifc.rvt file
question_paraphrase: Inconsistent rotation between Link IFC and linking the cached .ifc.rvt; subcontractors share the .ifc.rvt; detailed Tekla IFCs cleaned by script.
phrasing_notes: Describes real team workflow in detail
answer_summary: Logged in Autodesk Jira; open.

gloss_en: Where is the IFC entity to Revit family/category mapping documented? IfcOpenShell wall opens as BasicWall unless it has material layers.

gloss_en: Import class mapping table ignored when linking MEP IFC: IfcAlarmType etc. all go to Generic Model.

gloss_en: Multiple Revit levels at the same elevation all export to one storey, breaking import into Allplan drawing files.

phrasing_notes: Desperate tone, tried all settings, checked in 3 viewers
answer_summary: Workaround: offset the level by 0.0001; IfcSpatialContainer parameter does not help for equal elevations.

gloss_en: IFC exporter 21.2 dropped most steel elements and connected concrete; deliveries are IFC.
